spots.text: THE ISLAND WILL COME BACK FOR YOU. IT ALWAYS HAS SO FAR.
BELOW THE ISLAND. PLEASE KEEP THE TRAPDOOR SHUT: IT IS A LONG WAY DOWN, EVEN FROM HERE.

secrets.name: The Room Under the Island
secrets.text: The rug on the biggest island hides a trapdoor. Down the ladder, inside the raw stone underneath, someone has fitted out a room with a bed and a desk, and slept here, floating.

meta.label: The Floating Islands
meta.blurb: Pieces of a reading room float in the dark here, each with its desk and its lamp, as if the floor had simply come apart. They are roped off like exhibits. People step between them very carefully.
